_comment: Display face options for the picker. Add one here and it appears in the CMS dropdown (after you add its name to the options list in src/admin/config.yml). 'query' is the Google Fonts request, 'stack' is the CSS font-family, 'axes' is font-variation-settings (leave empty for non-variable fonts).

Fraunces.note: Quirky, angled terminals. The original choice.

Newsreader.note: Editorial and calm. Reads as publication rather than personality.

Instrument Serif.note: High contrast, elegant, a little fashionable.

Young Serif.note: Chunky and confident. Much heavier presence.

Spectral.note: Quiet and bookish. Makes the site feel like a journal.

Bodoni Moda.note: Classic didone. Hairlines thin out on dark backgrounds — best at large sizes only.

Playfair Display.note: Familiar and safe. Very widely used, which cuts both ways.

IBM Plex Serif.note: Matches the body and mono faces exactly. Most unified, least contrast.

Josefin Slab.note: Geometric slab. Tall x-height, art-deco feel, very different register from the others.
